description: Run speed tests and inspect results, statistics, and Ookla servers on a self-hosted Speedtest Tracker instance.

auth.label: API Token
auth.placeholder: Enter your Speedtest Tracker API token
auth.description: A bearer token created from /admin/api-tokens on your Speedtest Tracker instance. See https://docs.speedtest-tracker.dev/api/authorization.

extraFields.label: Instance URL
extraFields.description: The HTTPS root URL of your Speedtest Tracker instance, including any reverse-proxy subpath. Private-network instances require OOMOL_CONNECT_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK in a self-hosted Node deployment.

actions.name: check_health
actions.description: Check that the Speedtest Tracker instance is reachable and running through its unauthenticated health check endpoint.

inputSchema.description: The health check needs no input.

message.description: The upstream health message, normally `Speedtest Tracker is running!`.

actions.name: get_latest_result
actions.description: Retrieve the most recent speedtest result, optionally narrowed by the same filters as list_results, for example status `completed` for the last successful test. Requires a token with the Read Results ability.

ping.description: Filter by ping in milliseconds. Prefix the value with a comparison operator (<, <=, >, >=, or <>) for range queries, for example `>=20`; a bare number means equals.

download.description: Filter by download bandwidth in bytes per second. Prefix the value with a comparison operator (<, <=, >, >=, or <>) for range queries, for example `>=20`; a bare number means equals.

upload.description: Filter by upload bandwidth in bytes per second. Prefix the value with a comparison operator (<, <=, >, >=, or <>) for range queries, for example `>=20`; a bare number means equals.

healthy.description: Only include results whose benchmark evaluation matched this healthy flag.

status.description: Only include results with this status.

scheduled.description: Only include scheduled results (true) or manual dashboard results (false). Tests started through the API are stored as scheduled.

startAt.description: Only include results created on or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time, for example `2026-09-01` or `2026-09-01T00:00:00Z`.

endAt.description: Only include results created on or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time. A date without a time covers the whole day.

inputSchema.description: Optional filters applied before picking the newest result.

service.description: The speedtest service that produced the result, currently `ookla`.

actions.name: get_stats
actions.description: Retrieve aggregated ping, download, and upload statistics, optionally limited to a date range. Requires a token with the Read Results ability.

startAt.description: Only include results created on or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time, for example `2026-09-01` or `2026-09-01T00:00:00Z`.

endAt.description: Only include results created on or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time. A date without a time covers the whole day.

inputSchema.description: The optional date range for the statistics.

total_results.description: The number of results in the selected range.

avg.description: Average ping, rounded to two decimals.

min.description: Minimum ping, rounded to two decimals.

max.description: Maximum ping, rounded to two decimals.

avg.description: Average download bandwidth in bytes per second, rounded.

avg_bits.description: Average download bandwidth in bits per second, omitted when avg is 0.

avg_bits_human.description: Human readable average download bandwidth, omitted when avg is 0.

min.description: Minimum download bandwidth in bytes per second, rounded.

min_bits.description: Minimum download bandwidth in bits per second, omitted when min is 0.

min_bits_human.description: Human readable minimum download bandwidth, omitted when min is 0.

max.description: Maximum download bandwidth in bytes per second, rounded.

max_bits.description: Maximum download bandwidth in bits per second, omitted when max is 0.

max_bits_human.description: Human readable maximum download bandwidth, omitted when max is 0.

download.description: Aggregated download bandwidth statistics in bytes per second, with bits variants when the value is non-zero.

avg.description: Average upload bandwidth in bytes per second, rounded.

avg_bits.description: Average upload bandwidth in bits per second, omitted when avg is 0.

avg_bits_human.description: Human readable average upload bandwidth, omitted when avg is 0.

min.description: Minimum upload bandwidth in bytes per second, rounded.

min_bits.description: Minimum upload bandwidth in bits per second, omitted when min is 0.

min_bits_human.description: Human readable minimum upload bandwidth, omitted when min is 0.

max.description: Maximum upload bandwidth in bytes per second, rounded.

max_bits.description: Maximum upload bandwidth in bits per second, omitted when max is 0.

max_bits_human.description: Human readable maximum upload bandwidth, omitted when max is 0.

upload.description: Aggregated upload bandwidth statistics in bytes per second, with bits variants when the value is non-zero.

stats.description: Aggregated statistics with upstream field names. All averages are 0 when no result matches.

actions.name: list_results
actions.description: List speedtest results with optional filters, sorting, and pagination. Requires a token with the Read Results ability.

ping.description: Filter by ping in milliseconds. Prefix the value with a comparison operator (<, <=, >, >=, or <>) for range queries, for example `>=20`; a bare number means equals.

download.description: Filter by download bandwidth in bytes per second. Prefix the value with a comparison operator (<, <=, >, >=, or <>) for range queries, for example `>=20`; a bare number means equals.

upload.description: Filter by upload bandwidth in bytes per second. Prefix the value with a comparison operator (<, <=, >, >=, or <>) for range queries, for example `>=20`; a bare number means equals.

healthy.description: Only include results whose benchmark evaluation matched this healthy flag.

startAt.description: Only include results created on or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time, for example `2026-09-01` or `2026-09-01T00:00:00Z`.

endAt.description: Only include results created on or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time. A date without a time covers the whole day.

sort.description: The sort field; prefix with `-` for descending. Defaults to the instance insertion order, so use `-created_at` for newest first.

pageSize.description: Results per page, from 1 to 500. Defaults to 25. The instance can lower the maximum through API_MAX_RESULTS.

service.description: The speedtest service that produced the result, currently `ookla`.

actions.name: list_servers
actions.description: List nearby Ookla speedtest servers as seen by the instance, for choosing a serverId for run_speedtest. Requires a token with the List Servers ability.

id.description: The Ookla server ID. Numeric IDs are returned as integers so they can be passed to run_speedtest.

host.description: The server host and port, for example `speedtest.example.net:8080`.

location.description: The server city or location label.

servers.description: The servers returned by the instance, empty when it cannot reach Ookla.

actions.name: run_speedtest
actions.description: Queue a new Ookla speedtest on the instance and return the queued result immediately. Poll get_result with the returned ID until the status is completed, failed, or skipped. Requires a token with the Run Speedtest ability.

serverId.description: The Ookla server ID to test against, from list_servers. Omit to let the instance choose a server.

service.description: The speedtest service that produced the result, currently `ookla`.
